projects.name: mini-language-server
projects.repository_hygiene_notes: Frozen source contains README, docs, pyproject, src and tests but no top-level LICENSE file; migration preserves that source state exactly.
projects.integration_notes: The frozen source contains a bounded NovaFunctionAdapter with function/local/reference and nova.unresolved-name diagnostics. A cross-project audit found that its declaration regex currently accepts fn name(params) { ... } with bare parameters, while normative imported Nova requires typed parameters and an explicit -> return type. No full Nova-LSP interoperability is claimed until that grammar mismatch is implemented and regression-tested.
projects.attribution_notes: Complete reachable source main history scan passed before import; no configured attribution patterns matched. Source history is retained as umbrella ancestry, the subtree matched source blob-for-blob, and Python 3.13 editable-install, ruff and pytest gates passed before publication. Permanent umbrella CI mirrors the source Ubuntu/Windows/macOS × Python 3.11/3.13 matrix.

projects.name: mini-debugger
projects.integration_notes: Imported mini-elf-toolchain currently emits sectionless ET_EXEC images (e_shoff/e_shnum = 0), so umbrella integration intentionally validates address-level debugging rather than pretending symbol metadata exists: launch, read entry bytes, set a numeric software breakpoint at 0x400001, continue, and observe the breakpoint hit.
